note: Signal universe. LIVE source is the published Google Sheet CSV below (assetsincome tab, WHEEL + GROWTH columns) — read every scan. The wheel/growth lists here are a committed fallback cache used only if the sheet is unreachable; the cron refreshes them. Duplicates are deduped at read time.

anchors.label: ⚓ Anchors
anchors.description: Stable, low-vol names. Thin premium — high POP, capital preservation.

income.label: 💰 Income Diversifiers
income.description: Solid growth names with consistent mid-IV. Core wheel income zone.

growth.label: 🚀 Growth Engine
growth.description: High-beta, fat premiums. Active management needed. LEAPs & PMCC here.

iv_levels._note: Global IV classification (applies across all equity options). Use as a universal reference alongside per-ticker brackets.

low.label: Low IV
low.meaning: Thin premiums — wheel unattractive unless stock is already a conviction hold

mid.label: Mid IV
mid.meaning: Normal sell zone — standard wheel/CSP conditions

high.label: High IV
high.meaning: Rich premiums — verify no binary catalyst (earnings, FDA, etc.) before selling

extreme.label: Extreme IV
extreme.meaning: Elevated event risk — avoid selling naked exposure; PMCC or defined-risk only

iv_brackets._note: Per-ticker IV zones [low_max, mid_max, high_max] — calibrated to each ticker's normal vol range. Low IV = below [0]; Mid IV = [0]–[1] (sell zone); High IV = [1]–[2] (check catalyst); Extreme = above [2] (avoid).
